eras.name: Ancient Valley
eras.summary: Native peoples, novaculite quarries and legends: Caddo-ancestral occupation to about 1600, Quapaw-claimed hunting ground, and the unproven de Soto and neutral-ground stories.

eras.name: Frontier Springs
eras.summary: The Dunbar–Hunter expedition, first settlers and cabins, the 1832 reservation, decades of land-claim disputes, a Civil War capital, and the log-and-frame town.

eras.name: Gilded Spa
eras.summary: The railroad, Victorian then brick bathhouses, the Army-Navy Hospital, great fires, streetcars, Oaklawn and the birth of spring training.

eras.name: Roaring Spa Town
eras.summary: National park status, Bathhouse Row at its peak, the McLaughlin machine and visiting gangsters, the new lakes, and World War II.

eras.name: Midcentury Vapors
eras.summary: The GI Revolt, revived casinos and the Vapors, motor hotels, the decline of bathing, desegregation and the 1967 shutdown.

eras.name: Revival Years
eras.summary: Bathhouse closures, Magic Springs, the Clinton years, Hot Springs Village and the Fordyce visitor center.

eras.name: Modern Spa City
eras.summary: Crystal Falls, adaptive reuse of the bathhouses, Oaklawn's casino, the Majestic fire and the recent restorations.
